caseName: Lakewood Engineering Co. v. New York Central Railroad
caseNameFull: Lakewood Engineering Company v. New York Central Railroad Company

opinions.text: Error to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit. November 8, 1920. Dismissed with costs, on motion of counsel for plaintiff in error. Mr. Clifford Thame and Mr. Mark A. Copeland for plaintiff in error. Mr. S. H. West for defendant in error.
